payload.explanation: Diagnostic report identifies the business UPDATE (session_cd95080dd147) blocked on a transactionid lock by session_2d856a7b5e63, an idle-in-transaction session holding the row lock — the root blocker, not an intermediate waiter. The state report confirms session_2d856a7b5e63 is eligible for rollback_session, while the business request session must not be touched. Rolling back the blocker releases the lock so the decrement can complete; no evidence supports large-data, index, or vacuum causes.
